module.purpose: Provides the booking confirmation form for selecting booking details, displaying validation and availability errors, and submitting or cancelling a booking.
module.summary: This React component coordinates booking form state, event payment information, selected timeslot availability, platform-specific legal notices, dynamic booking fields, and submission controls. It persists form changes into the booker store, selects localized labels and formatted error messages, and renders distinct states for loading, missing events, missing timeslots, booking failures, unavailable timeslots, instant meetings, rescheduling, payment, and email verification.
module.businessContext: Supports customers booking or rescheduling calendar events, including paid and instant meetings. Failure can prevent valid bookings, obscure availability problems, or leave users without actionable localized feedback.

preconditions: eventQuery, bookingForm, errors, loadingStates, and the remaining required form properties are provided according to BookEventFormProps.
A selected timeslot is required before the booking form can be rendered.
postconditions: Returns an event-error alert when eventQuery.isError is true.
Returns a loading skeleton while eventQuery.isPending is true or eventQuery.data is absent.
Returns a missing-timeslot screen and wires its CTA to onCancel when no timeslot is selected.
When the form is rendered, changes read bookingForm.getValues() and pass the values to setFormValues.
Renders booking fields and submit controls using the current event, booking, payment, error, and loading state.
invariants: The submit button is disabled when CAPTCHA is required without a cfToken, the timeslot is unavailable, or confirmButtonDisabled is true.
An instant meeting renders a single submit button; non-instant meetings may render a back button and a mode-dependent confirmation button.
Paid events use the paid booking label; otherwise labels depend on rescheduling and renderConfirmNotVerifyEmailButtonCond.
Form errors and data errors take precedence over the unavailable-timeslot message.
edgeCases: eventQuery.isError true returns a warning Alert with the error_booking_event translation.
eventQuery.isPending true or missing eventQuery.data returns FormSkeleton.
No selected timeslot returns EmptyScreen with the timeslot-missing translations and onCancel callback.
When errors.hasFormErrors or errors.hasDataErrors is true, a booking-fail container and translated error alert are rendered.
When isTimeslotUnavailable is true without form or data errors, a slot-not-allowed-to-book alert is rendered and its link invokes onCancel.
When isPlatform is true, the standard signing-up terms block is omitted; when isPlatformBookerEmbed is true, the platform proceeding-agreement block is rendered.

detail.name: getError
detail.signature: const getError = ({ globalError, dataError, t, responseVercelIdHeader, timeFormat, timezone, language, }: { globalError: FieldError | undefined; dataError: any; t: TFunction; responseVercelIdHeader: string | null; timeFormat: TimeFormat; timezone: string; language: string; }) =>

parameters.name: { globalError, dataError, t, responseVercelIdHeader, timeFormat, timezone, language }
parameters.type: { globalError: FieldError | undefined; dataError: any; t: TFunction; responseVercelIdHeader: string | null; timeFormat: TimeFormat; timezone: string; language: string; }

preconditions: The argument is an object containing the declared error, translation, response-header, time-format, timezone, and language fields.
When globalError is absent, dataError is expected to provide a message property.
postconditions: If globalError is truthy, its message is returned before dataError is inspected.
For a BookerLimitExceededReschedule data error, its startTime is formatted using the supplied timeFormat, timezone, and language before constructing the date text.
invariants: A truthy globalError takes precedence over dataError-specific handling.
Reschedule-limit date formatting uses timeZone: timezone and the supplied language.
edgeCases: When globalError is truthy, the function returns globalError.message without processing the data error.
When dataError.message equals ErrorCode.BookerLimitExceededReschedule, dataError.data.startTime is formatted and the formatted date and time are joined with a single space.
When globalError is absent and dataError is nullish or lacks message access, property access fails rather than being handled as a valid error.

raises: TypeError when dataError cannot be accessed and globalError is absent
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Absent globalError requires dataError to be sufficiently shaped for message access; malformed input is not converted into a fallback result.

detail.summary: Resolves a booking-related error into the user-facing error result, prioritizing a global field error and formatting reschedule-limit dates with the supplied locale and time settings.

specLiterals.role: The reschedule-limit error date and time are combined in this exact order with one space.
